questions.q: Which cell is most responsible for the fibrosis?

questions.stem: A 62 year old woman with cirrhosis becomes confused with a flapping tremor after a large protein meal and a GI bleed. Her glucose and sodium are normal and there is no ophthalmoplegia. Her blood ammonia is raised. A student asks why the liver disease causes her confusion.

questions.stem: A 59 year old man with cirrhosis has ascites and ankle oedema. His albumin is 22 g/L and INR 1.7. He bruises easily. He takes no anticoagulants and his urine dipstick shows no protein. A student asks how cirrhosis causes both his swelling and his bruising.

Raised splanchnic capillary pressure with reduced synthesis of albumin and clotting factors
